scope: Source-only reviewed Responses charge model and offline converter characterization; not provider attestation or production admission

limitations: Public synthetic strings; actual schema and OpenAI converters, no provider call
Converter output is not complete transport/proxy final-wire attestation
Omitted store/background fields do not establish upstream storage/background behavior

control_plane_lib.ignored_reason: requires owned disposable Restate fixture and private Unix relay

testing_gaps: The Responses rounding fixture uses input 0.900003 and output 1.800003 microUSD, whose separately rounded sum and rounded combined sum both equal 3. Add a case with both terms below one microUSD and a combined value at most one (for example one token at rate 1 for each), asserting two microUSD before fees/attempts; this distinguishes the documented separate-rounding guarantee from under-reserving aggregate rounding.

Responses invalid-model, invalid-review-digest, missing-price and exact-integer-range cases call contract.validate() directly. Add at least one invalid-evidence case through RouteReview::route_bound with a complete expected inventory, so omission of contract validation at the reservation entry point cannot silently retain green tests.

peer.coverage: adversarial lens: in-process fallback (cross-model peer not run: Claude route transport unavailable before egress: Internal error; no other eligible installed target)

code_review.followup: Both testing gaps closed by strengthening existing tests; both corresponding mutants fail at the intended assertions.
